append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1655). Premise re-tested first on main at 8b0b1909e: app/(main)/network/page.tsx read .limit(DIRECTORY_FETCH_LIMIT) (500) profiles by name and ran every filter, the name search included, over that slice in the page, rendering the first 48. /circles/page.tsx carries no cap on main, so this row stayed /network only. WHAT CLOSED IT: lib/connections/directory-page.ts applies the listing gate (is_active, directory_visible, not ghost_mode, the demo gate) and every filter (region ids, Circle and City member ids, online cutoff, topic, role with null as member, sanitised name/handle search) in the query; the member cards are a separate async component behind a Suspense boundary keyed on the query, reading one .range() page of 48 ordered by display_name then id, with ?page= in the URL beside the filters and a Prev / Next pager. Nearby-first ordering survives: the members_near lead goes first on page 1 and is excluded from the alphabetical read, so page boundaries stay exact. A page past the end clamps to the last page; a failed read throws to the route error boundary instead of rendering as no matches. Members Worldwide is an exact head count; Online now is its own scoped read; the facet options and Most popular place read a bounded sample (1000, PostgREST max_rows), which never decides who is listed or found. Every returned row still passes isListableInDirectory. No migration. Tests: lib/connections/directory-page.test.ts (a 900-member in-memory community finds member 842 by name; opted-out and ghosting members never list; every member of 1234 reached exactly once across pages with a nearby lead), lib/connections/directory-visibility.test.ts pin updated to the scoped reads.
